sections.section_title: RCC peripherals independent clock configuration register 2 (RCC_CCIPR2)
sections.text_helper: Section 6.4.21 "RCC peripherals independent clock configuration register 2 (RCC_CCIPR2)" in chapter 6 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 159.
sections.section_content:
This register is only available on STM32C071xx. On the other devices, it is reserved.
Address offset: 0x58
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:13 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 12 USBSEL: USB clock source selection
Set and cleared by software.
0: HSIUSB48
1: HSE
Bits 11:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
